planDocument: dispatch://INFRA-571 document plan.md (the full plan; tasks and proofs below are its summary)
summary: Move every pin of pgvector 0.8.7-pg16 (sha256:7b822b0a…) to 0.8.7-pg18 (mirror.gcr.io/pgvector/pgvector@sha256:2358fcba361ed2233a5ed81b5fe4ca779ccb304120ce531a3bf51c0ed7e2bc11) with every tmpfs/volume mount moved from /var/lib/postgresql/data to /var/lib/postgresql (the 18 entrypoint refuses the old mount); gcp:Dispatch defaults to POSTGRES_18 with a breaking README/CHANGELOG notice; dev-postgres.sh refuses a stale dispatch-pg with one printed dump-and-restore sequence; pgmigrate's scanner reads \v as space like Postgres 17+; envoy-go prints the service's server_version_num and pgvector version.

decisions.decision: Default changes to POSTGRES_18 with no IgnoreChanges; unset stacks upgrade in place at their next pulumi up after the pin moves; README/CHANGELOG say so and say to set databaseVersion: POSTGRES_16 to keep 16.
decisions.reason: Spec's README sentence and INFRA-572's explicit databaseVersion; IgnoreChanges hides state drift and is not in the acceptance. Risk to architect: an agent-infra pin move before INFRA-572 upgrades production unannounced.

decisions.decision: PR title feat(envoy-infra)!: with a BREAKING CHANGE: footer.
decisions.reason: An irreversible database upgrade for unset stacks; collateral majors for legion-envoy and pi-legion are routine on main (feat(broker)!:, feat(sandbox)!:).

decisions.decision: Every pgvector-digest site moves to 18 in the mirror.gcr.io form (8 CI service blocks, testpg, dev-postgres, dev-broker test, corpus-copy, acceptance compose, 7 devbox e2e scripts, skill-scenarios rig).
decisions.reason: One image, one version; spec names pr-and-main.yaml; the production instance holding Dispatch, broker and daemon databases moves to 18 with INFRA-572; AGENTS.md mirror rule.

decisions.decision: Out of scope: daemon-only postgres:16 scratch databases (stage1/stage2/controller-start/stage4b pg_container/record-casts, scripts/e2e/README.md:111,218), docs/kubernetes.md:4093 Job example, docs/site/media/broker/README.md:57, autodeploy.sh pg_dump 16, docs/plans and docs/solutions.
decisions.reason: Not Dispatch's database and not the pgvector pin; dated measurements; autodeploy dumps an Aurora 16 server this repo does not version.

decisions.decision: No pg16 CI lane during the window before INFRA-572.
decisions.reason: INFRA-572 is blocked only by this issue; P5 proves this head's migrations on 16. Architect: sibling INFRA-148 reviewers watch for 17+ features until INFRA-572.

decisions.decision: A print-only 'Postgres service version' step in envoy-go.
decisions.reason: The spec's acceptance asks CI's service to report its version; a Go test asserting 180000 would fail pod rigs on 17.

decisions.decision: pg_upgrade run: an older main build migrates 16 to ~0100 and seeds (incl. HNSW rows), pg_upgrade to 18, this head applies 0101+ on the upgraded cluster; one-off, script attached to the issue.
decisions.reason: Exercises migrations both carried by pg_upgrade and applied after it; no permanent harness was asked for.

tasks.work: Default POSTGRES_18; instance-input test rows unset->POSTGRES_18 and POSTGRES_16->POSTGRES_16; README resources row and inputs paragraph with the in-place-upgrade notice (cite Google's major-version upgrade page); CHANGELOG Breaking entry. dispatch_cloud.go untouched.

One value mirror.gcr.io/pgvector/pgvector@sha256:2358fcba361ed2233a5ed81b5fe4ca779ccb304120ce531a3bf51c0ed7e2bc11; tmpfs mounts to /var/lib/postgresql. Done when rg for the old digest (outside docs/plans) prints nothing and every remaining /var/lib/postgresql/data mount is a postgres:16 out-of-scope site.

Pinned mirror digest; delete image_major/mount detection/volume-move/no-volume/major branches; one printed sequence for any stale container: [docker start if stopped], pg_dumpall --clean --if-exists > ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/dispatch-pg-<12hex>.sql, stop, rename, run pinned, pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 until ready, psql -h 127.0.0.1 -f - < dump (expected role errors named), vector + server_version_num check, rm backup and dump; put-back lines kept; message no longer claims 'no pgvector'. Tests: absent/reuse/start kept; stale-running on old pin, stale-stopped (starts with docker start), stale postgres:16 with no pinned image; replay of run and restore lines; quote table.
Mirror digest; volume dispatch-acceptance-pg18 at /var/lib/postgresql; README sentence on removing the old dispatch-acceptance-pg volume.
isSQLSpace and quote-continuation whitespace add \v (Postgres 17+ scan.l); comments say Postgres 18; test for \v as space and string continuation; first confirm no migration holds \v.

Step 'Postgres service version': docker exec the service container, psql -Atc "select current_setting('server_version_num'), coalesce((select default_version from pg_available_extensions where name = 'vector'), 'no vector')"; prints only.

files: any test failing on 18; likely internal/dispatch/outbox/publisher_test.go:1204, refs/excerpts_test.go:63, store/graph_edges_test.go:136, api/replies_plan_test.go:36, internal/explaintest
tasks.work: Fix from the 18 behaviour that changed; never loosen an assertion; record each fix and cause in the PR body.
One sentence each naming PostgreSQL 18 / the pinned pgvector-on-18 image / pgmigrate reading SQL as Postgres 18 (exact sentences in plan.md Task 8).

Before the first push: ASD-STE100 Envoy message to notifications.role.legion-infra-infra-63-architect naming gcp/dispatch.go:25 only (dispatch_cloud.go untouched), dispatch_test.go:129 + one new test, README.md:140,151-152, CHANGELOG [Unreleased] ### Changed, and Decision 1's risk; record its id/time in implement.json.

specDepartures.spec: Lists dev-postgres.sh, testpg.go and the CI service images as the sites that move to 18, and the envoy-infra default.
specDepartures.plan: Also moves every other pin of the same pgvector digest (corpus-copy.sh, dev-broker.test.sh, the acceptance compose file, seven devbox e2e scripts, the skill-scenarios rig) with their data mounts, rewrites dev-postgres.sh's stale-container refusal as one dump-and-restore sequence, makes pgmigrate's scanner read \v as Postgres 17+ does, and adds a print-only CI step for the server version.
specDepartures.evidence: 23 lines in 17 files pin sha256:7b822b0a… (rg --hidden, outside docs/plans); the 18 entrypoint (lines 248-262) refuses a mount at /var/lib/postgresql/data; dev-postgres.sh:76 would tell every developer their old-pin container 'has no pgvector'; scan.l 16 vs 18 differ in \v.

outcome.scope: Wider than the three named sites: every pin of the pgvector digest and the code that models the Postgres version (pgmigrate scanner); daemon-only postgres:16 scratch databases stay out.
